description: Fetch one venue's VERIFIED non-alcoholic menu by slug: every NA item we have read off the venue's own published menu (name, description, price where printed, category, drink style and NA brands where identifiable, on-draft flag) plus the date that menu was last confirmed. Venues without a verified menu return an explanatory error rather than an invented list. Read-only.

slug.description: The venue's stable slug, e.g. 'sans-bar-austin' — from search_venues or find_drink.

name: get_menu
